fields.title: Sangyō Bumon Kyōkyū Wariate Chōsei ni Kansuru Gyōsei Hōkoku

report.subject: Tanaka Hiroshi no ukeru kōgyōyō kyōkyū wariate fuguai ni kansuru chōsa
report.author: Yamamoto Kenzo

fields.summary: Kōgyō bumon ni okeru rōdōsha no saiteki seikatsu suijun o mamoru tame no kyōkyū wariate fuso ni kansuru gyōsei chōsa hōkoku.
findings: Kyōkyū shizai no zaimu kiroku oyobi rōdōsha meibo ni yori, genzai no wariate ga rōdō jin’in ni taishi fujūbun de aru koto ga hanmei shita.
Shinseisha Tanaka Hiroshi no seikyū wa, rōdōsha no katsudō o iji suru tame ni datō de aru.
recommendations: Kōgyōyō kyōkyū wariate o zōryō shi, seikatsu kijun o mitasu koto o kyoka suru.

claims.fact: Gyōsei hōkoku wa, kyōkyū wariate ga rōdō jin’in ni taishi fusoku shite ita jijitsu o nintei shite iru.
